usage: The word 燒味 (siu1 mei6) is a noun referring to Cantonese style roasted meats, such as roast pork and roast duck.
You can use 燒味 to talk about dishes made of these roasted meats at restaurants or street food stalls.
When ordering food, 燒味 can be specified as a category on menus or as a type of meat you want to eat.
The term 燒味 can also be part of compound phrases like 燒味飯 (roast meat rice) or 燒味拼盤 (mixed roast meat platter).
It often appears without measure words when speaking generally but you can add measure words like 份 (fan6) for a serving.
